obligations.summary: A general-purpose AI model must be classified as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk if it has high impact capabilities evaluated on the basis of appropriate technical tools and methodologies, including indicators and benchmarks.

A general-purpose AI model must be presumed to have high impact capabilities, and thus classified as systemic risk, when the cumulative computation used for its training exceeds 10^25 floating point operations.

The Commission shall adopt delegated acts to amend the classification thresholds and supplement benchmarks and indicators in light of evolving technological developments to ensure thresholds reflect the state of the art.

A general-purpose AI model shall be classified as having systemic risk based on a Commission decision, issued ex officio or following a qualified alert from the scientific panel, where the model has capabilities or impact equivalent to high impact capabilities having regard to the criteria in Annex XIII.
